title: TRUNCATE preceded by a keyed snapshot — recovery artefact exists
expected_feedback: Standard, not critical: the script takes a full copy of the table before the statement runs, so the recovery artefact this check asks for does exist. The residual risk is what the snapshot does not cover — confirm it is the right table, that the CTAS actually completed, and that someone owns dropping it once the migration is signed off. The statement itself remains irreversible: it auto-commits, resets the high-water mark, and Flashback Table cannot cross it, so recovery means reinserting from the snapshot rather than undoing anything. On Standard Edition 2 that snapshot would be the only recovery mechanism available, since Flashback Table TO SCN/TIMESTAMP is Enterprise Edition only.
violated_rule: Irreversible statements need a pre-DDL artefact
